slices.focus: A casual Hawks game outing with coworkers becomes a recurring post-season ritual, giving Ayaka low-stakes social recovery and a simple mental side street.
slices.summary: Ayaka watches a Hawks game with coworkers at a tiny bar near the terminal and finds herself genuinely enjoying it — the rhythm of the game, the relaxed company, the absence of logistics talk. She starts checking standings between shifts, learning a few player names, and treating game outings as a welcome default for free weekends. She keeps it budget-sensible (one drink, shared snacks) and recognizes it as a form of sideways closeness — connection without emotional intensity.
open_loops: Interest could fade or become a budget leak if not kept modest
May need to protect the ritual from becoming another obligation
decisions: Ayaka now follows the Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks more actively than before and treats occasional games with terminal coworke
